description: Least-privilege IPC surface for the local Jarvis windows (quickbar, HUD, desktop widget). The frontend reaches every privileged operation — capture, health, chat streaming, approvals, clipboard, notifications, widget geometry — through app-defined commands in commands.rs, which are not permission-gated, so no clipboard-manager, notification or global-shortcut plugin permissions are granted here. There is deliberately no `remote` block: the HUD window loads http://127.0.0.1:4719 over plain HTTP, and without a remote grant that origin gets no IPC at all, so an XSS on the HUD web app cannot reach the host.
